title: GPU Capacity Delivery Match
purpose: Bind a GPU capacity order to allocation, machine evidence, health evidence, and a probe manifest so the buyer can accept, pay, dispute, or route the receipt.

rules.description: The order must carry a reservation_id or order_id.
Delivered GPU count must match the ordered count. Missing delivery evidence is UNKNOWN; conflicting count is CONTRADICTED.
Delivered GPU SKU or GPU class must match the order. Missing delivery evidence is UNKNOWN; conflicting SKU/class is CONTRADICTED.
Delivered region and zone evidence must match the order when declared. Missing delivery evidence is UNKNOWN; conflicts are CONTRADICTED.
DCGM evidence must declare the diagnostic level that ran and a PASS result. The rule does not require a universal diagnostic level.
A probe manifest must be present and bound to the same reservation/allocation/machine. Missing manifest is UNKNOWN; wrong binding is CONTRADICTED.
